name: tamirs-superpowers
description: Multi-platform agent plugin: worktree-based dev workflow, repo standards, and MCP tooling. Skills install separately (see docs/user/install/gemini.md).

settings.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
settings.description: GitHub personal access token (repo scope) for the bundled github MCP server. Stored in the system keychain and handed to scripts/github-mcp.sh as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; nothing else in the extension reads it. Leave it empty to keep the server off - it refuses to start without one.
